fixed_stage_placement.reason: Avoids actual carriage_forward_plate versus M03 rear-foot material intersection without moving HU, changing capture, editing source geometry or widening the C08 envelope.

old_failure.note: SAT projection overlap is not Euclidean penetration depth. New support placement removes this material overlap without a tolerance waiver.

limitations: This is a bounded static geometry proof, not engine, supplier handover, traffic, queue or strength certification.
Nine actual stage support witnesses span the native load-bearing base; no claim that every point of the open M03 top supports the entire projected pallet area.
Source internal vehicle/driver construction and adjacent cosmetic joins are retained; this pass checks affected foreign HU/M03/vehicle pairs only, without hierarchy exemptions.
Concave L-fork AABB overlaps are resolved with closed-oriented boundary-triangle sweep separation and exterior winding, not by treating convex-hull overlap as penetration.
Source STAGE_IN_W_BULK is a soft reservation, not a solid wall; exclusive use of its handling corridor remains required. Other cell02 and N3 stow reservation envelopes are retained.
The actual page uses A132; the same 64 continuous checks also pass B164 independently.
Finite native contact witnesses, conservative continuous envelopes and explicit source proof scopes are kept separate.

reproduction.instructions: Extract audit_sources to their exact repo-relative paths only when absent or hash-identical. With frontend package-lock dependencies installed, run the commands below. No ignored source data is needed beyond these embedded audit programs; the Node command regenerates source-route.json before Python.

audit_sources.source:
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, hashlib, json, sys
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OWN=ROOT/'work/v3/heavy-inbound-physics-20261109'
PACK=ROOT/'docs/v3/contract-proposals/n2-n3-physical-interfaces-v1'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('source_route_math',PACK/'route_math.py');math=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(math)
packet=json.loads((PACK/'route-terminal-interfaces.json').read_bytes())
candidate=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/adaptive-v3/fixtures/layout-plans/dense-manual-b-164-v1.json').read_bytes())
route=json.loads((OWN/'source-route.json').read_bytes())
profile=next(p for p in packet['loaded_profiles']if p['archetype_id']=='PALLET_LOAD')
components=profile['component_bounds_local_m']
def inflated(box):return{'min':[v-2e-6 for v in box['min']],'max':[v+2e-6 for v in box['max']]}
use_a='--layout-a' in sys.argv
modules=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/v3/contract-proposals/storage-layout-v3.json').read_bytes())['modules']if use_a else candidate['modules']
obstacles=[{'id':m['module_id'],'bounds':m['operating_bounds_world']}for m in modules]
for o in candidate['fixed_obstacles']:
    if 'FL01' in o['id'] and ('park' in o['kind'] or 'vehicle' in o['kind']):continue
    if o['id']=='STAGE_IN_W_BULK' and o['kind']=='source_staging_reservation':continue
    obstacles.append({'id':o['id'],'bounds':o['bounds']})
# Both existing-template M03s remain inside their finite cells. The first is a
# separately named new visual placement, not a mutation of the published packet.
stage1={'id':'v3:visual-heavy-inbound:support:IN_W_BULK:01','bounds':{'min':[15.19999998,0,13.41000001],'max':[16.80000002,.18,14.80999999]}}
stage2={'id':'v3:n2:support:IN_W_BULK:02','bounds':{'min':[21.19999998,0,13.25000001],'max':[22.80000002,.18,14.64999999]}}
obstacles.extend([stage1,stage2])
obstacles.extend([{'id':'other-stage-cell-02-reservation','bounds':{'min':[19.4,0,13],'max':[24.6,8,15]}},{'id':'N3-stow-station-reservation','bounds':{'min':[25.8,0,13.3],'max':[30.2,8,14.7]}}])
checks=[]
for suffix in ['empty_arrival','loaded_departure']:
    connector=next(c for c in packet['connectors']if c['connector_id']=='v3:n2:staging:IN_W_BULK:01:PALLET_LOAD:'+suffix)
    boxes=components[:1]if suffix.startswith('empty')else components
    for i,s in enumerate(connector['segments']):
        g=s['geometry'];kind=g['kind']
        if kind=='line':g=math.line(s['start_pose']['position_m'],s['end_pose']['position_m'],s['start_pose']['yaw_rad'])
        else:g=dict(g,start_yaw_rad=s['start_pose']['yaw_rad'],end_yaw_rad=s['end_pose']['yaw_rad'])
        result=math.prove_segment(g,[inflated(b)for b in boxes],[o for o in obstacles if o['id']!=stage1['id']])
        checks.append({'kind':suffix,'index':i,'geometry':g,'own_terminal_support_checked_separately_by_native_handling':True,**result})
for i,a in enumerate(route['source_arcs']):
    result=math.prove_segment(a['geometry'],[inflated(b)for b in components],obstacles)
    checks.append({'kind':'source_loaded_arc','index':i,'arc_id':a['arc_id'],**result})
# Target-graph to prepared is a source-heading 50mm connector, not an in-place yaw.
g=math.line([120.8,0,17.5],[120.85,0,17.5],3*3.141592653589793/2)
checks.append({'kind':'target_50mm_graph_connector',**math.prove_segment(g,[inflated(b)for b in components],obstacles)})
# The controlled target approach is permitted to enter ONLY its actual intended
# M03. All other source modules/stock reservation envelopes remain obstacles.
g=math.line([120.85,0,17.5],[119.8,0,17.5],3*3.141592653589793/2)
checks.append({'kind':'target_controlled_approach','excluded_support':'v3:module:HEAVY_E:001','own_terminal_support_checked_separately_by_native_handling':True,**math.prove_segment(g,[inflated(b)for b in components],[o for o in obstacles if o['id']!='v3:module:HEAVY_E:001'])})
paths=['docs/v3/contract-proposals/n2-n3-physical-interfaces-v1/route_math.py','docs/v3/contract-proposals/n2-n3-physical-interfaces-v1/route-terminal-interfaces.json','docs/adaptive-v3/fixtures/layout-plans/dense-manual-b-164-v1.json']
if use_a:paths.append('docs/v3/contract-proposals/storage-layout-v3.json')
result={'passed':all(c['passed']for c in checks),'source_kind':'visual_fixture','engine_operation':False,'source_hashes':{p:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()for p in paths},'source_safety_padding_m':.25,'native_rounding_enclosure_margin_m':2e-6,'source_C08_component_bounds_unchanged':components,'obstacle_count':len(obstacles),'checks':checks,'interval_tests':sum(c['interval_tests']for c in checks),'exclusive_own_staging_reservation_required':'STAGE_IN_W_BULK','limitations':['Static geometry only; reservations and one-clock ledger remain separate.','The own STAGE_IN_W_BULK soft reservation is not a material wall; exclusive handling-space ownership is required. Other cell02 and N3 stow allocations are retained as obstacles.','Actual intended terminal M03 is excluded only from its own approach envelope; native fixed-yaw handling clearance covers its actual triangles.','Source tyre steering and immutable vehicle structure retained; no new full-world native triangle gate or source-supplier handover claimed.']}
result['layout_variant']='A132'if use_a else'B164'
result['source_storage_module_count']=len(modules)
result['validated_recipe']={'stage_support_position':[16,0,14.11],'stage_support_yaw_rad':0,'stage_engage_position':[16,0,12.6],'target_engage_position':[119.8,0,17.5],'cargo_reach_relative_z_m':.6,'cargo_travel_vehicle_local_z_m':1,'helper_source_sha256_from_native_test':'11cc3f0cd92a17bf6d376d6b041343e70fe7f46ee3b88599668407eb047aebba'}
result['runtime_source_observation_not_used_by_route_math']={'path':'frontend/src/adaptive-v3/warehouseHeavyInboundPhysics.ts','sha256':hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'frontend/src/adaptive-v3/warehouseHeavyInboundPhysics.ts').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(OWN/('route-checks-A132.json'if use_a else'route-checks.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'passed':result['passed'],'checks':len(checks),'interval_tests':result['interval_tests'],'failed':[c for c in checks if not c['passed']]}))
